main.description: etzhayyim 信者 membership oath record. Per ADR-2605172600. Recorded on the aspirant's PDS at the time of joining, carries the signed oath + on-chain join() tx reference.

oathTextVersion.description: Lexicon-tracked oath text version. v1 = the original 2026-05-17 text. Bumps when canonical text revises.

oathTextLanguage.description: Language variant the aspirant signed. Both ja and en are canonical; aspirant signs one (their choice).

oathText.description: Full oath text as signed. Must match the canonical text for the (version, language) pair byte-exact.

oathHashKeccak256Hex.description: keccak256(utf8(oathText)) lower-case hex without 0x prefix. Used as the bytes32 argument to EtzhayyimMembership.join().

did.description: Aspirant's DID. did:web:* / did:plc:* / did:key:* accepted.

didSignatureBase64url.description: DID-bound signature over the oathText bytes. Verification: resolve did → publicKey → verify against oathText. base64url no padding.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID. v0.1 = 8453 (Base mainnet) or 84532 (Base Sepolia testnet).

membershipTxHash.description: 0x-prefixed transaction hash of the EtzhayyimMembership.join() call.

smartWalletAddress.description: 0x-prefixed ERC-4337 Smart Account address that signed the on-chain join().

githubUsername.description: Optional github handle. Matches the second argument to join() if provided. Used by MEMBERS.md PR validation.
